name: A Chance to be Saved
overview: For eleven years, filmmaker Doron Tsabari followed Eviatar Banai with an open and unfiltered lens, creating a body of footage unlike anything previously seen on Israeli television. Through rare archival material and a rich tapestry of music, this documentary series offers an intimate portrait of one of Israel's most beloved artists, revealing the man behind the songs and the long, winding journey of his creative life.
